cleanup.confirm: This will delete all local Homelander data.

setup.personaDesc: Tell Homelander who you are — this fills IS24 contact forms.

search.title: Searches
search.pasteUrl: Paste a full IS24 search URL

backendUnavailable.title: Backend unavailable
backendUnavailable.message: Homelander is still starting up. Try again in a moment.

browserStartFailed.title: Could not open Chromium
browserStartFailed.message: Homelander could not start its bundled browser. Restart the app and try again.

browserNotResponding.title: Chromium is not responding
browserNotResponding.message: The controlled Chromium session stopped responding. Restart Chromium or restart Homelander.

sessionExpired.title: Login needed
sessionExpired.message: Homelander needs you to log back into IS24 before it can continue applying.

searchUrlInvalid.title: Search URL not accepted
searchUrlInvalid.message: This does not look like a usable IS24 search URL. Paste the full search results URL from IS24.

searchPollFailed.title: Could not poll this search
searchPollFailed.message: Homelander could not refresh listings for this search. IS24 or the network may be temporarily unavailable.

configSaveFailed.title: Could not save settings
configSaveFailed.message: Homelander could not save the settings. Try again or restart the app.

databaseError.title: Could not read saved data
databaseError.message: Homelander could not read or write its local database. Restart the app.

captchaKeyInvalid.title: 2captcha key not accepted
captchaKeyInvalid.message: 2captcha did not accept this key. Check the key or leave it empty.

cleanupConfirmationFailed.title: Email does not match
cleanupConfirmationFailed.message: Type the configured email exactly to confirm.

csvExportFailed.title: Could not export history
csvExportFailed.message: Homelander could not export the selected history rows.

daemonActionFailed.title: Daemon action failed
daemonActionFailed.message: Homelander could not change the daemon state. Try again or restart.

listingRetryFailed.title: Could not queue retry
listingRetryFailed.message: Homelander could not queue this listing for retry.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.message: Homelander could not complete that action. Details were logged.
